Paid Opportunity Check: No Registration Fee, Participation Fee, Payment Requirement, or Candidate-Side Charge Is Mentioned in The Provided Content.

Vortex 2 K26 – Global Ai Innovation Hackathon:

Build. Innovate. Impact.

  • Join on Whats App Community for Instant Updates:
  • Https://whatsapp.Com/channel/0029 Vb Dbyw N2f3 E Jaickj41y
  • Vortex 2 K26 Is a Global Online Hackathon Organized by Innovation Hacks, Bringing Together Students, Developers, Innovators, and Ai Enthusiasts to Build Technology-Driven Solutions for Real-World Challenges.
  • Participants Are Encouraged to Transform Ideas Into Working Prototypes Using Artificial Intelligence, Generative Ai, Machine Learning, Automation, and Emerging Technologies.

Hackathon Themes:

  • Ai for Bharat & Public Services
  • Build Intelligent Solutions for Citizen Services, Accessibility, Multilingual Communication, Governance, and Public Infrastructure.
    • Climate, Agriculture & Rural Innovation
  • Develop Solutions for Sustainable Agriculture, Climate Resilience, Water Management, Waste Reduction, and Rural Development.
    • Health Tech & Human Wellbeing
  • Create Accessible and Innovative Solutions for Healthcare, Preventive Care, Medical Assistance, Accessibility, and Wellness.
    • Future of Education & Employability
  • Build Solutions for Personalized Learning, Skill Development, Career Guidance, Assessments, and Employment.
    • Deep Tech, Automation & Emerging Technology
  • Explore Ai Agents, Robotics, Computer Vision, Cybersecurity, Io T, Automation, and Next-Generation Technologies.

Team Size:

  • Solo Participation Is Allowed
  • 1–4 Members per Team
  • Inter-College Teams Are Allowed
  • Interdisciplinary Teams Are Allowed

️ Technology:

  • Participants Are Free to Use Any Programming Language, Framework, Ai Model, Api, Platform, or Technology Suitable for Their Solution.

Hackathon Process:

  • Register Your Team
  • Select a Theme and Identify a Problem
  • Build Your Solution
  • Submit Your Project
  • Final Evaluation & Winners Announcement

Submission:

  • Teams May Be Required to Submit:
  • Project Title
  • Problem Statement
  • Git Hub / Source Code Link
  • Demo / Deployment Link

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Projects Will Be Evaluated Based On:
  • Innovation & Originality
  • Technical Implementation
  • Real-World Impact
  • Usability
  • Scalability
  • Presentation & Demo

Certificates & Recognition:

  • 1st Prize – Winner Certificate
  • 2nd Prize – Winner Certificate
  • 3rd Prize – Winner Certificate
  • Participation Certificates Will Be Provided to Eligible Participants.

Rules:

  • Each Participant Can Be Part of Only One Team.
  • Maximum 4 Members per Team.
  • Solo Participation Is Allowed.
  • Inter-College and Interdisciplinary Teams Are Allowed.
  • Projects Must Be Original Work Created by The Participating Team.
  • Plagiarism or Unauthorized Copying Is Not Permitted.
  • Participants Must Submit Their Projects Before the Specified Deadline.
  • Incomplete or Inaccessible Submissions May Not Be Considered.
  • Organizers Reserve the Right to Disqualify Submissions that Violate the Rules.
  • The Judges' Decision Will Be Final.

Organized By:

Innovation Hacks

  • Build. Innovate. Impact.
  • Https://www.Innovationhacks.In/
  • Have an Idea? Build It. Solve a Problem. Create an Impact.
  • Welcome to Vortex 2 K26.
